COMMUNITY SUBMISSION (UNVERIFIED)

Posted October 25, 2026: A submitted argument claims two Seymour vertices in every sink-free oriented graph, but explicitly uses the original one-vertex theorem as a premise; it is therefore not an independent proof of this conjecture.

Current status (as of October 2026): Several restricted cases are settled or claimed, but the unrestricted conjecture remains open, and the submitted two-vertex strengthening is unverified and conditional.
